spans.s:
ऋक्शत n. (-तं) A hundred texts.
 E. ऋच् a prayer, and शत a century.

ऋक्संहिता f. (-ता) The collection of the prayers and hymns of the Rik
Veda.
 E. ऋच् and संहिता compendium.
ऋक्ष r. 5th cl. (ऋक्ष्णोति) To kill, to hurt or seek to hurt.

ऋक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Pierced, cut, divided.
 mn. (-क्षः-क्षं) A star, a con-
stellation.
 m. (-क्षः)
 1. A mountain in the peninsula, the temporary
residence of

. A bear.
 3. A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
 E. ऋष्
to go, Unādi affix स, the radical final then becomes क, and स be-
comes ष; and क and ष form the compound letter क्ष.

ऋक्षगन्धा f. (-न्धा)
 1. A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.)
 2.
Another sort, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)
 E. ऋक्ष a bear, and गन्ध
smell, smelling like a bear.

ऋक्षगन्धिका f. (-का) A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus paniculatus, the
pale sort:) see the preceding. E. As before, कन् added.

ऋक्षर n. (-रं) A shower, a stream.
 m. (-रः) A family priest.
 E. ऋष् to go,
and सर Unādi affix: see the derivation of ऋक्ष.

ऋक्षविभावन n. (-नं) Observing or seeing the stars.
 E. ऋक्ष and विभावन
noticing.

ऋक्षेश m. (-शः) The moon.
 E. ऋक्ष a star, ईश lord.

ऋक्षेष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) Offering worship to the planets and stars.
 E. ऋक्ष and
इष्टि worship.
